scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n shared,server,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run build -w shared -- --watch" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
